title: fix(adr-0087): a dotted member path walks interface and type-literal alias bodies
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDypKu7B9nwbu5WuV7AEio8)_
Fixes #37445
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:内部的 ADR 登记检查现在能沿“接口”和“对象类型别名”找到成员,只有写变更说明的开发者会看到区别。
- 为什么做:补全登记检查的成员路径能力,替修改公开接口成员的开发者解决“接口成员的收窄无法按名字登记”的问题。
- 出错会怎样:检查若读错,只会错误拒绝或错误放行一条登记,不影响任何运行中的产品,可直接撤回。
- 要你做的:无。

## What changes

`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, the structural member-path walk behind `type-surface-only path#A.B.member` references:

- `containerBodiesFor` now unions four container kinds: object literals and classes (as before), plus **interface declarations** (`interfaceBodiesFor`: `export` / `export default` / `declare` prefixes, type parameters, `extends`; body located by `declarationBodyStart`) and **type-literal aliases** (`typeAliasBodiesFor`: `type X = {` with or without type parameters, the `=` found by `aliasEqualsIndex`; the RHS must begin with an object type literal, and that literal is the body walked).
- `objectLiteralBodiesFor` no longer claims the braces of `type X = {` (`followsTypeKeyword`), so a plain alias is counted once, under its own kind, instead of twice.
- **Same zero-or-several refusal** for the new kinds. **Declaration merging is pinned as AMBIGUOUS, not merged**: two `interface X` blocks are two bodies ("opens 2 interfaces"), even when the member sits in only one block; a class and an interface of one name are ambiguous across kinds ("opens 2 class bodies and interface bodies").
- Refusal text names the new shapes: "no `X` object literal or class, nor interface or type-literal alias (... `interface X {` or `type X = {`), is declared ...". Predicate 4's HEAD-side refusal prose names them too.

The #38093 position reader (`sitsInTypePosition` / `braceOpensTypeBody` / `functionTypeReturn`) is untouched; its pins R8, R9, G2, U31 to U37 run green in the same self-test.

## Tests

New battery `TSO-I (#37445)` (floor 20), in the gate's own `--self-test`:

- I1: the card's shape (`AuthClient.updateUser`, a function-typed property signature) resolves to its return type; I2: a method signature on the same interface.
- I3: negative control, the bare `updateUser` still reads the first definition in the file; I4: top-depth rule inside an interface, three spellings land on three different definitions.
- I5: an interface whose name prefixes the segment (`AuthClientSession`) is not entered; I6: refusal names every shape looked for; I7: `export declare interface` with a type-parameter default and a brace-bearing `extends`.
- I8, I9: declaration merging is AMBIGUOUS (also when the member is in only one block); I10: class plus interface of one name is ambiguous across kinds.
- I11, I12: generic and plain type-literal aliases resolve, the plain one once; I13: an alias of a non-literal type is refused as absent.
- I14 to I16, end to end through `scan()`: the dotted interface marker is green; the bare spelling of the same diff is red (`narrowed-from-erased`); a merged interface at HEAD is red as AMBIGUOUS.

```text

```

```text
HEAD  ui/packages/auth/src/types.ts#AuthClient.updateUser -> surface "the return annotation of AuthClient.updateUser", type Promise of AuthUser, erased false
BASE  -> refusal "no `AuthClient` object literal or class (...) is declared at the top of the file."
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Finding (not fixed here, outside this card's walk): `braceOpensTypeBody` reads its header only back to the previous brace, so an interface whose heritage carries a type literal (`interface P` with type parameter `T extends { id: string }`) is not classified as a type body, and a function-typed property inside it reads as UNANNOTATED (erased). Measured on `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/SortableFavoriteRows.tsx#SortableFavoriteRowsProps.renderRow` at adfdb84b: "carries NO return annotation", though it is annotated. The bare spelling reads the same today. Reported to the seat for filing; the TSO-I fixture keeps its brace-bearing heritage case on a method signature, which does not depend on that reader.
- Merging is refused rather than merged by design (card ruling: the same zero-or-several refusal). Naming a member of a merged interface stays impossible until one block is renamed; that is the honest state.

## Verification

Read first: `interfaceBodiesFor` / `typeAliasBodiesFor` (the new regexes), `followsTypeKeyword` (the double-count guard), `describeBodies` (the refusal wording TSO-C9 pins).

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test` prints the success line with 854 assertions.
